subject: 67 documentation line refs point at blank lines or bare braces
description: Measured 2026-09-20 by the new _tools/docs/verify-doc-line-refs.js across all of _docs: 495 refs checked, 67 IMPOSSIBLE (blank line, bare punctuation, lone comment marker, past EOF) and 95 unresolved paths. A file:line citation is this repo's convention for every technical claim and it rots silently the moment anyone inserts a line above it. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION before anyone 'fixes' these: many sit in DATED HISTORICAL docs (SESSION-HANDOFF-2026-06-15.md, security-plus-navigation-audit-2026-06-21.md, dr-hex-latency-2026-05-26.md, wsa-quiz-review-scope-2026-06-15.md) whose refs describe the tree AS IT WAS at that date. Repointing those at today's lines would falsify the record rather than repair it - the right fix for a historical doc is either to cite a COMMIT rather than a line, or to state the commit the line numbers were taken at, or to leave it and accept it as an artifact. The live docs (BUG_TRACKER.md has the largest share, plus the architecture set) are the ones worth repairing against current code. The 95 unresolved are mostly bare basenames like 'console.html' that match 3 files; fully qualifying them is what makes them checkable at all. Run: node _tools/docs/verify-doc-line-refs.js --all
